description: This file defines a validation rule class 'InAccessibleEmpNumbers' used to determine if an employee number is accessible based on user role and authentication context within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: InAccessibleEmpNumbers
classes.description: Validation rule class that checks if an employee number is accessible based on user roles and authentication context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes whether to include the logged-in employee's number in the validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the provided employee number is accessible, considering the user context and role-based access control.
